Use case: background-extraction / precise-object-edit.
The input is a six-view design sheet. Extract ONLY the upper left / FRONT panel's sculpture as ONE separate reference PNG, for the RED KING porcelain blacksmith.
Keep the exact camera angle, silhouette, head tilt, hands, drapery, cap/crown, apron or black-and-gold decoration, props, ivory base geometry and glazed ceramic rendering IN THAT SPECIFIC PANEL. Do not borrow the angle from any other panel. Do not invent a new pose or design. Remove all sheet text, labels, borders, lines, other figures and white background. Preserve ivory-white ceramic parts; they are not background.
Preserve the entire upright figure AND pedestal exactly; never crop top or base. Do not add a second figure.
Output a square image with genuine transparent RGBA background, no white or colored canvas, no floor, no cast shadow, no checkerboard drawing. One full object centered, generous 8% transparent padding; preserve original aspect ratio. All opaque white porcelain remains intact; only background is transparent. Do not relight or alter ornament placements. No text, no watermarks.
